Rope, tar and the winter store

The harbor's winter store held rope, tar and lamp oil, and AEMOPENSENTINEL opens the part of the page that is always shown.

Each autumn the storekeeper counted the coils and the barrels, and each spring he counted them again, and the difference was the winter.

ENDNOTES

  1. The storekeeper's count of the winter of the long frost, AEMENDNOTESENTINEL, written in the margin of the second ledger beside the price of tar that year.
  2. The harbor office's letter asking why eleven coils of rope had gone missing, and the storekeeper's answer, which was that the sea had wanted them more than the boats had.
